description: Frozen graph-ambiguity corpus for the M2 experiment (name-based call resolution across modules). Pins same-name, alias, import, re-export, and method resolution cases with predeclared precision/recall thresholds; the resolver evaluation itself remains gated behind M2's frozen-threshold disposition.
